name: Xshielder iPhone 17
summary: The Xshielder iPhone 17 is a flameproof (Ex db) case for the Apple iPhone 17, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 17 running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.
imageAlt: Apple iPhone 17 inside the Xshielder Ex case

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T6 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db

safety.conditions: Flameproof Ex db enclosure (dust: Ex tb). Specific conditions of use (FIDI 26 ATEX 0025X / IECEx FIDI 26.0019X): no repair of flameproof joints; fasteners only replaced with identical ones (min. tensile strength 500 MPa); tested for low impact energy, do not expose to high impact risk; enclosure must not be opened in hazardous area; S02 (cemented lid) must not be opened by the user; battery charging only outside hazardous area. Either variant may only be opened by Xshielder-authorised personnel. USB-C port not accessible: charge wirelessly (MagSafe) outside the hazardous area.

specs.camera: 48 MP Fusion main + 48 MP Fusion ultra wide (2x optical-quality)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 30 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)
specs.gnss: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou, NavIC
specs.keys: Action Button; Camera Control; side; volume
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

throughCase.label: Camera Control
throughCase.value: No (no dedicated Camera Control button on any Xshielder cover; Action button can open camera)

throughCase.label: Side and volume buttons
throughCase.value: Power and volume keys on cover

throughCase.label: Front camera
throughCase.value: Yes: 18MP Center Stage front camera with Face ID

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Usable through Gorilla Glass; keyboard haptics recommended

throughCase.label: Wireless charging
throughCase.value: Yes: up to 25 W (outside Ex area only)

throughCase.label: MagSafe accessories
throughCase.value: Yes: designed for the Apple MagSafe charger through the rear glass window (charging outside Ex area only); MagSafe accessories not stated

throughCase.label: Speaker and microphone
throughCase.value: All 4 microphones and 2 speakers usable; output reduced vs bare iPhone (Voice Isolation or Ex Bluetooth headset recommended)

throughCase.label: Headset audio
throughCase.value: Bluetooth only (USB-C not accessible; Ex-certified Bluetooth headset recommended)

throughCase.label: USB-C / Lightning port
throughCase.value: Not accessible (charging and data wireless only)

throughCase.label: SIM card
throughCase.value: eSIM; physical SIM can be installed by Xshielder on request

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (Push to Talk framework); Action Button (programmable key on cover) mappable

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (QR via Camera) / Via app (1D/2D)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (Core NFC); not verified through metal enclosure

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Built in on iPhone; not verified through enclosure

variants.name: S02
variants.description: Cemented lid. ATEX and IECEx certified.

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Estimated from Apple's minimum commitment of five years from first sale. Apple usually supports iPhones for longer.
unconfirmed.specs.ram: Apple doesn't publish RAM. This is the widely reported figure.
unconfirmed.specs.battery: Apple doesn't publish battery capacity. Figure from regulatory filings and teardowns.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.
unconfirmed.specs.ipRating: The Ex certificate gives IP6X (dust-tight) only. We found no Xshielder document that states a water rating.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
T6 temperature class, the strictest rating
Security updates expected until at least September 2030
A standard Apple iPhone 17 inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: IECEx covers the S02 (cemented lid) version only
Only authorised personnel may open the case
NFC and satellite SOS not confirmed to work through the enclosure
